name: Sorra Finance
rootCause: Sorra was suspected to have been attacked on ETH, resulting in an approximate loss of $43K.

descriptions.text: Sorra was suspected to have been attacked on ETH, resulting in an approximate loss of $43K.

Sorra Finance’s staking contract was exploited on January 4, 2025, when an attacker drained about 3 million SOR tokens (valued at roughly $41,000) by repeatedly claiming the same staking rewards. The core vulnerability was a flawed reward calculation logic: the contract failed to track previously distributed rewards, allowing the attacker to withdraw rewards multiple times with sequential withdrawals. The getPendingRewards() function did not deduct previously withdrawn rewards, enabling repeated claims of the same reward balance without updating the accounting state. No mechanism,such as a rewardDebt or lastClaimedAt variable,was in place to track distribution per user.
